# Egoist managed UTF8 bindings
Source-only fork of k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx v1.13.4 commit142807252687d81b40d6315f23470a1512a00de3. All 98 upstream C# sources retain SherpaOnnx namespace/public API. AssemblyName Egoist.Sherpa.Onnx.Utf8, version1.13.4.1, targetnet8.0. No NuGet dependencies. Apache-2.0 LICENSE and upstream copyright headers retained; exact original/patched/source archive hashes in source-manifest.json.
All 162 explicit LPStr fields/parameters use LPUTF8Str; two borrowed native strings use PtrToStringUTF8. Native C API uses UTF8; existing Windows converter turns paths into UTF16. Native DLLs/frontend/model bytes are unchanged.
OfflineRecognizer rejects native NULL context/stream. OfflineStream rejects NULL result and releases acquired results in finally. Public null handles and use-after-dispose fail with managed exceptions. Wrappers remain single-owner objects; this patch does not make concurrent Dispose/Decode safe.
The project compiles src/**/*.cs.txt explicitly with default items disabled; it additionally accepts src/**/*.cs after intentional rename. .cs.txt avoids accidental app recursive compilation. Update the manifest if renaming.
Build: dotnet build vendor/sherpa-managed-utf8/1.13.4/Egoist.Sherpa.Onnx.Utf8.csproj -c Release
Integration owned by root: remove org.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx managed reference, explicitly retain org.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.runtime.win-x64 1.13.4, add this ProjectReference and exclude vendor/**/*.cs from the app. Do not include experimental corrected native frontend.
Reproduce patch in pristine pinned checkout: git -c core.autocrlf=false apply --check /absolute/path/utf8-binding.patch, then apply. Fresh apply produced all 98 exact accepted bytes. One upstream CRLF file is normalized to LF, with its original trailing blank line retained.
Evidence: artifacts/quality-2.3.1/managed-utf8/verification.json. All 673 public surface entries/102 public types are unchanged; all 67 interop structs retain every size and field offset. Public plainRNNT smoke passed single/batch/eight repeated and disposal cycles using Cyrillic+Chinese+emoji paths and UTF8 options. Stock ASCII/fork ASCII/fork Unicode output hashes agree. Explicit runtime.win-x64 consumer actually loaded exact stock CAPI+ORT checked by SHA256. Native NULL context/stream/result fault injection and real bad-config/double-dispose tests passed.
Limits: smoke covers public plainRNNT, not every declared TTS/model API. No accuracy gains claimed. No user Data or production settings read/changed. No new native GPL runtime distributed by this source-only patch.

Build hashes depend on Platform/RID and SDK Git SourceRevisionId/SourceLink metadata. The source manifest buildArtifactSha256 describes the isolated Release AnyCPU smoke artifact; it is not an expected production DLL pin. Source hashes are authoritative. Two fresh isolated x64 builds are byte-identical; cross-profile/root binary equality is not claimed.
